body.zh:
你带来的三封信，分别交给旅店里的阿槐、药剂铺里的闻弦，还有钟楼前的老柯。

镇里的街灯只剩两份灯油，恰好够照亮一条路。请先听听他们的打算：药包要送到旅店，旧钟也需要一段新绳。

你的随身提灯有自己的小油芯，不占街灯的两份油。准备妥当后，去钟楼前作决定。
body.en:
Deliver your three letters to A-Huai at the inn, Wen-Xian at the apothecary, and Old Ke by the clocktower.

Two measures of streetlamp oil remain: enough for one route. Hear them out first. The inn needs medicine; the bell needs a new cord.

Your portable lantern has its own small wick. It does not use the streetlamp supply. Decide at the clocktower when preparations are complete.

text.en: Fold the note; deliver the letters

speaker.zh: 第一封信 · 苔灯旅店

body.zh:
「我妹妹还活着。」阿槐将信压在账本下，指尖却迟迟没有离开。炉边多摆了几双鞋：有人从北面的旧堤走来，有人一路没有说话。

「闻弦替楼上的孩子备了药。你若愿意，就把药包带回来。入夜后，巷口亮着，他们才敢下楼取水；可钟楼那边也在等人。」

她没有催你点灯，只先挪开一张椅子。
body.en:
“My sister is alive.” A-Huai presses the letter beneath her ledger, keeping a finger on its edge. Extra shoes line the hearth. Some travelers came from the old northern embankment; some have not spoken.

“Wen-Xian has medicine for the child upstairs. Would you bring it? A lit lane will let them fetch water tonight. But people are waiting at the tower too.”

She offers you a chair before asking for a lamp.

body.zh:
「账本里只有三间房，楼上却住了七个人。旧堤塌了，他们没了身份证明，我不愿让他们站在雾里等到天亮。」

她拿起一串大小不一的钥匙：「点亮旅店巷，会让这里的人安稳些。钟声若停了，河上的人就未必找得到归路。别把我的话当成唯一的答案。」

窗边一只空杯里，插着孩子折的纸船。
body.en:
“Three rooms are in the ledger. Seven people are upstairs. The embankment took their papers, and I would not leave them waiting in the fog.”

She lifts a ring of mismatched keys. “Light the inn lane and these people can rest. If the bell stops, those on the river may lose their way. Do not take my wish as the only answer.”

A child's folded paper boat sits in an empty cup.

body.zh:
「药剂铺就在广场东边，门前有绿色的草药招牌。把闻弦的药包带回来吧，我会把热水留着。」

阿槐看了看你的提灯：「出门小心脚下。井边的绳子湿了，药包可不能沾水。」
body.en:
“The apothecary is east of the square, beneath the green herb sign. Bring Wen-Xian's medicine; I will keep the water warm.”

A-Huai glances at your lantern. “Watch your step. The well rope is wet. Keep the packet dry.”

body.zh:
她拆开纸封，念了一遍闻弦写的剂量，然后把药包与热水一同端到楼梯口。楼上传来一声轻轻的「谢谢」。

「这件事已经做好了，不论你最后点亮哪条路。」阿槐回来后这样说。「灯油不够，并不意味着我们什么都不能做。」
body.en:
She opens the paper seal, reads Wen-Xian's dosage, and carries the packet and hot water to the stairs. A quiet thank-you comes from above.

“This is done, whichever route you choose to light,” she says on returning. “Too little oil does not mean we can do nothing.”

body.zh:
药已送到楼上，炉边的鞋子也摆整齐了。阿槐没有再请求什么，只告诉你，钟楼前的老柯在等最后的安排。

「如果今晚这条巷子没有灯，我会锁好门，陪他们一起等。你作决定时，至少要知道门后是谁。」
body.en:
The medicine is upstairs; the shoes are neatly aligned. A-Huai makes no further request. Old Ke at the tower is waiting for the final arrangements.

“If this lane stays dark, I will lock the door and wait with them. When you decide, at least you should know who is behind it.”

speaker.zh: 第二封信 · 雾叶药剂铺

body.zh:
闻弦读完信，把一小瓶琥珀色的药水放回架上：「南岸的船会在夜里到。我的父亲老柯守着钟楼，他总说钟声能穿过看不见岸的雾。」

她递来封好的药包：「先替我给阿槐。里面是给楼上孩子的退热药。灯油只有两份——点巷子，孩子能安睡；点钟路，船上的人能回来。」

「先把能做的做好，再选灯照哪里。」
body.en:
Wen-Xian reads her letter and replaces an amber bottle. “The south-bank boat arrives tonight. My father, Old Ke, keeps the tower. He says a bell can cross fog when a shore cannot be seen.”

She offers a sealed packet. “For A-Huai's feverish child. We have two measures of oil: light the lane for the child, or the tower route for those returning by boat.”

“Do what can be done first. Then choose where the light falls.”

body.zh:
「父亲从来不肯带药。我把药瓶放到他口袋里，他又放回我的架上。今晚我想去钟楼陪他，也想看看旅店里的孩子。」

她把怀表翻到背面，磨损的字迹写着：给第一次独自出诊的闻弦。

「我不会替你选。入夜之后，我会沿你点亮的那条路走过去。剩下的路，得等天亮再走。」
body.en:
“Father never takes his medicine. I slip a bottle into his pocket; he returns it to my shelf. Tonight I want to sit with him, and check the inn's child too.”

She turns an old watch over. Its worn inscription reads: For Wen-Xian's first house call alone.

“I will not choose for you. After dark, I will follow the route you light. The other visit will wait for daylight.”

body.zh:
「药包已经交给你了。阿槐会记得剂量。老柯若还没修好钟绳，去广场的井边找找，那段打过蜡的旧绳还可以用。」

药剂铺的窗子映着逐渐暗下来的天空。闻弦把瓶塞一一按紧，等你最后的选择。
body.en:
“You have the packet. A-Huai will remember the dosage. If Old Ke still needs a bell cord, look beside the well. The waxed old rope can be used.”

The shop window reflects the fading sky. Wen-Xian checks each stopper and waits for your decision.

body.zh:
老柯把信举到眼前，读到船期时，手杖轻敲了一下石路。「还有人回来，那就该让钟走起来。」

「旧钟绳断了。广场井边那段打过蜡的绳还结实，你取来，我就能把钟修好。修好不等于一定要点这条路——灯油还是只有两份。」

他指向西面的旅店：「先把药送到那边。最后回来找我，把两条路的事一起想清楚。」
body.en:
Old Ke holds the letter close. At the boat's arrival time, his stick taps the stones. “If people are returning, the bell should be ready.”

“The bell cord is broken. Fetch the waxed rope by the well and I can repair it. Repairing it does not commit the oil. There are still only two measures.”

He points west. “Deliver the medicine first. Then return and consider both routes together.”

speaker.en: Old Ke puts down his watch

body.zh:
「是我剪断的。昨夜没有灯，钟机卡住，响在了不该响的时候。河上的船把它当成靠岸的信号。幸好没有人落水，但他们很久才找到真正的码头。」

「我不想再用钟声替黑暗许诺一条安全的路。今晚若点亮钟路，我才敢重新敲钟；若你选择旅店，我就守着修好的钟，等明早。」

他没有把错误推给雾。
body.en:
“I cut it. Without a lamp last night, the mechanism jammed and rang at the wrong time. A boat took it for a landing signal. Nobody fell, but they searched a long time for the real quay.”

“I will not let a bell promise a safe road through darkness again. Light this route and I can ring it. Choose the inn, and I will keep the repaired bell quiet until morning.”

He does not blame the fog.

speaker.zh: 老柯 · 钟绳尚未修复

body.zh:
「广场井边的桶旁边，有一段打过蜡的旧绳。把它取来就好。药也记得给阿槐。」

老柯用手杖指了指钟楼底下的两只小油罐：「它们就在这里。无论先做哪件事，我都会等你回来。」
body.en:
“A waxed rope sits by the bucket at the square's well. Bring it here. Remember A-Huai's medicine too.”

His stick points at two small oil tins beneath the tower. “They will remain here. Whichever errand you do first, I will wait.”

title.en: A new knot beneath the bell

speaker.en: Old Ke takes the waxed rope

body.zh:
老柯慢慢试了两个结，绳子从他的掌心滑过。他轻拉了一下，钟舌终于回到正位。

「现在它能响了。但要照亮路，我才能让船认得这一声。旅店那边也有他们要等的夜晚。先确认药送到了，再来作决定。」
body.en:
Old Ke tests two knots and feeds the cord through his palm. A gentle pull returns the clapper to its place.

“It can ring now. But the road must be lit for a boat to trust it. The inn has its own night to endure. Make sure the medicine is delivered, then decide.”

speaker.zh: 老柯 · 药已送达，钟已修好
speaker.en: Old Ke · medicine delivered, bell repaired

body.zh:
两份灯油恰好够一条街的灯烧到清晨，无法分给两边。

照亮旅店巷：阿槐会开门，闻弦去看孩子；钟楼路留在黑暗里，钟声暂歇。
照亮钟楼路：老柯敲钟引船，闻弦陪他守灯；旅店锁门，客人留在炉火边。

这一次选择会耗尽两份油。随身提灯仍可使用。
body.en:
Two measures keep one route lit until dawn. Splitting them will leave both dark too soon.

Light the inn lane: A-Huai opens her door and Wen-Xian visits the child; the tower road stays dark and its bell quiet.
Light the tower route: Old Ke rings for the boat and Wen-Xian joins him; the inn locks its door and guests wait by the hearth.

Either choice spends both measures. Your portable lantern remains usable.

text.zh: 照亮旅店巷 · 耗尽2份
text.en: Light the inn lane · spend both

text.zh: 照亮钟楼路 · 耗尽2份
text.en: Light the tower route · spend both

speaker.zh: 阿槐 · 旅店巷已点亮

body.zh:
旅店的门开着，闻弦已从东边走来。阿槐把热水端到门口，楼上的孩子退了热。几位客人第一次走到巷子里，抬头看见了路灯。

远处的钟楼没有响。老柯仍守在那里，河上的归人今晚要等更久。

「你没有把所有夜晚都照亮。」阿槐说，「但我们记得这一盏。」
body.en:
The inn door is open. Wen-Xian has come from the east. A-Huai brings hot water to the threshold; the child's fever has eased. Guests step into the lane for the first time and look up at its lamps.

The distant bell is silent. Old Ke still waits there, and those on the river must wait longer.

“You could not light every night,” A-Huai says. “But we will remember this one.”

speaker.zh: 老柯 · 钟楼路已点亮

body.zh:
老柯拉下新钟绳。钟声沿着亮起来的石路传向河岸，雾里很快回应了三声船哨。闻弦扶着他的肩，终于把那瓶药塞进了他的口袋。

西面的旅店锁上了门。孩子已经拿到药，但客人今晚仍待在炉火边。

「船认得这条路了。」老柯轻声说，「明早，我们再去敲阿槐的门。」
body.en:
Old Ke pulls the repaired cord. The bell follows the illuminated stones toward the river. Three boat whistles answer from the fog. Wen-Xian steadies his shoulder and finally slips his medicine into his pocket.

The western inn has locked its door. The child has medicine, but its guests will stay by the hearth tonight.

“The boat knows the way,” Ke says. “Tomorrow, we will knock on A-Huai's door.”

body.zh:
你已经把灯油给了另一条路。这边的人知道你的决定，也知道药已经送达、钟已经修好。

余下的事情要留给天亮。去点亮的那条路看看吧，有人正在等你收下今晚的回信。
body.en:
The oil went to the other route. These people know your decision, and know that the medicine was delivered and the bell repaired.

What remains must wait for daylight. Visit the illuminated route: someone is waiting with tonight's reply.

title.en: First night · Those who kept a light

body.zh:
你送出了三封信、带回药包、修好了旧钟，并把仅有的两份灯油留给旅店巷。

窗后的陌生人今晚成为了客人；钟楼路上的归人还在等待。没人说这个决定轻巧，阿槐只在回信上多写了一行：我们记得你来过。

你可以继续走走，或重来这一夜，看看另一条路。
body.en:
You delivered three letters, brought medicine, repaired the bell, and spent the town's two measures of oil on the inn lane.

The strangers behind its windows became guests tonight. Those returning by the tower route still wait. Nobody calls the decision easy. A-Huai adds one line to her reply: We remember that you came.

Keep exploring, or begin again and see the other route.

body.zh:
你送出了三封信、带回药包、修好了旧钟，并把仅有的两份灯油留给钟楼路。

归船听见了可信的钟声；旅店里的客人守着炉火等待天亮。没人说这个决定轻巧，老柯只在回信上多写了一行：明早一起去敲门。

你可以继续走走，或重来这一夜，看看另一条路。
body.en:
You delivered three letters, brought medicine, repaired the bell, and spent the town's two measures of oil on the tower route.

The returning boat heard a bell it could trust. The inn's guests stayed by the hearth until daylight. Nobody calls the decision easy. Ke adds one line to his reply: Tomorrow we knock together.

Keep exploring, or begin again and see the other route.
